definitions.explanation: High-quality ceramic material made from kaolin, fired at high temperatures to create a hard, white, translucent surface.

examples.japanese: この{磁器|じき}は{有田焼|ありたやき}です。
{磁器|じき}の{茶碗|ちゃわん}は{割|わ}れやすい。
{中国|ちゅうごく}は{磁器|じき}の{発祥|はっしょう}の{地|ち}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: China is known as the birthplace of porcelain.

notes:
{磁器|じき} refers specifically to porcelain, the finest type of ceramic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磁器|じき}の{皿|さら} (porcelain plate)
- {磁器|じき}の{人形|にんぎょう} (porcelain doll)
- {白磁|はくじ} (white porcelain)
- {青磁|せいじ} (celadon)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {磁器|じき}: porcelain (high-quality, translucent ceramic)
- {陶器|とうき}: pottery, earthenware (lower-fired, porous)
- {焼|や}き{物|もの}: pottery, ceramics (general term)

HOMOPHONES:
- {磁器|じき}: porcelain
- {磁気|じき}: magnetism
- {時期|じき}: time, season, period
